Summary
: The Sri Bhakti-rasamrta-sindhu is an ontological analysis of the pastimes of Shri Krishna presented in Shrimad-Bhagavatam (Bhagavata Purana), in terms of the internal structure and stages of development of uttama-bhakti, pure devotional service to the Lord. To the less intelligent, Shrimad-Bhagavatam is a book of religious stories; to those who are actually intelligent, however, it is a guide to the highest stages of spiritual consciousness.
Alternative titles: Śrī Bhakti-rasāmṛta-sindhu (श्री भक्ति-रसामृत-सिन्धु), Bhaktirasāmṛtasindhu (भक्तिरसामृतसिन्धु)
